title: Emergency assistance in India
content: India's Emergency Response Support System uses 112 as a pan-India emergency number for police, fire and rescue, health, and other emergency assistance. This assistant cannot place an emergency call or contact responders.
source_title: Emergency Response Support System in India

title: Finding official disaster alerts in India
content: The NDMA SACHET portal provides official, geo-targeted disaster alerts and links to alert information from authorized sources. Check the portal or follow local authorities for current alerts. This dashboard is a simulation and is not connected to SACHET or a live alert feed.
source_title: NDMA SACHET National Disaster Alert Portal
